test_multiindex_insert: test the MultiIndex.insert method to insert a tuple at a specified position in a MultiIndex
test_multiindex_append: test the MultiIndex.append method to concatenate multiple MultiIndex objects together
test_multiindex_repeat: test the MultiIndex.repeat method to repeat each element of a MultiIndex a given number of times
test_multiindex_delete: test the MultiIndex.delete method to remove an element at a specified position from a MultiIndex
test_multiindex_append_names: test the MultiIndex.append method behavior when index level names match or do not match
